sentences.en: I think your father hoped you would go to college.
sentences.zh: 我认为你父亲希望你能上大学。

sentences.en: We had hoped that the rain would stop before noon.
sentences.zh: 我们本来希望雨会在中午前停下来的。

sentences.en: I am hoping to get two copies of this book.
sentences.zh: 我希望我能得到这本书的两本副本。
